title: Would You Like…?
intro: Would you like something to eat?

words.sentence: Would you like some juice? Yes, please!
Would you like some soup? No, thank you.
Would you like a sandwich? Yes, please!

parentTip.vi: Lúc ăn vặt, hỏi con "Would you like a biscuit?" và chờ con đáp "Yes, please!" hoặc "No, thank you."
